howto: SHIPPED AS: a READ-ONLY VERIFY of the 15 P06 wings the proven P06 kit imported 7 Oct -- the live positive control of this kit's generalised gate (expect FLATV3_RZIMPORT_VERIFY_OK|..|wings=15). It writes no asset.

0 Editor open on L_InfinityStage_V1VerticalSlice, NO PIE, census CLEAN. Offline first: python Saved/CodexFlatV3/rzimport/rzimport_core.py <manifest> [...] -> rzimport_plan_offline.json (gates + batches + APPLY confirms).

1 DRY: set manifests to the new IMPORT_MANIFEST_v2_<passage>.json paths (project-relative; several allowed), mode DRY, confirm 'DRY RZIMPORT' -> FLATV3_RZIMPORT_DRY_OK|run=..|plan=<hash8> and one DRY_CONFIRM line per batch

2 APPLY one batch per MCP call: {mode APPLY, batch k, confirm 'APPLY RZIMPORT BATCH k #<hash8>', manifests: same list}; wait for FLATV3_RZIMPORT_APPLY_OK|run=..|plan=..|batch=k (parse by run id) before the next
3 VERIFY (read-only), same manifests -> FLATV3_RZIMPORT_VERIFY_OK|..|wings=N + rzimport_verify_<hash8>_LATEST.json (rzswap's make_swap_plan reads it)
UNDO (manual only): mode UNDO_LIST, confirm 'UNDO_LIST RZIMPORT' (or offline python rzimport.py --undo-list) -> rzimport_undo_list_<hash8>.json
Run each with: python Saved/CodexMocap/mcp_request.py tools/call --params-file Saved/CodexFlatV3/rzimport/rzimport_request.json --timeout 600
On FLATV3_RZIMPORT_STOPPED during APPLY before the save: do NOT save anything; Don't-Save editor restart; DRY again.
